events.title: Update 0.123.5.4.1
events.summary: This was supposed to be a small update with some fixes, but we ended up implementing a bunch of new features as well! 😅 First of all, the konbini is now open for 24h business! You can buy all kinds of ingredients there, with the huge benefit that everything your buy there will arrive immediately! (In a future patch, things ordered in the fax machine will arrive the next day) We also now have a end of day reward system in place! events.title: Demo Update 0.123.5
events.summary: After a lot of hard work we’re introducing an update to our demo of Ramen Shop Simulator! This patch focuses on how you learn the game, how you track your progress, and that all your hard work in your ramen shop is saved. Highlights Save System: Your progress is now saved! events.title: Demo 2 - Store update!
events.summary: It’s here: our first content update! We welcome the first (of many) stores to Ramen Shop Simulator. This store is a mail order one in the shape of a fax machine, you’ll be able to order food, decorations and more from it! All food etc you order will be delivered immediately outside your restaurant! For now, we've waived the delivery fee. Decorations will appear magically in your decoration storage! Patch Notes Features: New: In-game store! New: Right-click a decoration in the decoration storage
